findings.panel: scrimColor ink + D9 drew the navy panel 0.149 to 0.154 opaque in harness execution 4737, because GraphicsMagick reads the last pair of an 8 digit colour as transparency. Confirmed by an independent verifier from the pixels, the GraphicsMagick 1.3.49 source and a GraphicsMagick 1.3.42 render, in which 26 drew 0.855 opaque.

proof.result: All four succeeded on the instance with the live Download Still and Compose nodes.
